selection: All articles in the frozen input JSONL
chunking: Abstract retained as one passage; body split by punctuation into groups of four sentences; each stored context capped at 3000 characters including provenance.
background_selection: Lowest SHA256(seed + title) among complete articles in fixed s-nlp/kilt parquet shard 0000; seed hydrabench-retrieval-20261104.
topic_selection: Case-informed source candidates and related distractors; no model results used. Exact seed candidates retained.
